lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Do you have the fourteen inch ThinkPad in stock?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.ne: छ। सिल्भर र कालो दुवै रङमा, सोह्र जीबी र्‍याम, दुई वर्षको वारेन्टीसहित।
lines.text: Yes, in silver and black, sixteen gigabytes of memory, with a two year warranty.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Until what time are you open today?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.ne: बेलुका सात बजेसम्म। तपाईंको नाममा एउटा छुट्याएर राखूँ?
lines.text: Until seven this evening. Shall I keep one aside in your name?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes please, the black one. Ramesh.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.ne: भयो रमेशजी। कालो थिंकप्याड सात बजेसम्म काउन्टरमा तपाईंको लागि राखिन्छ।
lines.text: Done, Ramesh. The black ThinkPad will be kept for you at the counter until seven.
